name: All Generations Gauntlet
description: One persistent draft through every regional Gym, Trial, Elite Four and Champion campaign.
mechanics_assumptions: Original-team mode preserves each Red/Blue trainer roster, order, and recorded moves
Filled-team mode uses six KoalaBattle-authored competitive Pokemon themed on each trainer
Campaign battles normalize both teams to the same deterministic stage level
Event-origin minimum levels are ignored only so every legal drafted Pokemon can use that shared stage level
Original teams add only explicit legal abilities required by the modern engine; filled teams also carry authored items, natures, EVs, and IVs
Difficulty modes raise only the opponent above the shared campaign level curve; the player's level never changes

After the eighth badge and before the Elite Four, the player chooses one legal drafted Mega Evolution; that stone can activate once per battle while Z-Moves, Dynamax, and Terastallization stay disabled
The Elite Four and Champion are one gauntlet: Pokemon knocked out there stay out until the run leaves it

source.variant: Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar and Paldea
source.compatibility_note: Each regional section keeps its canonical story roster and heals at its own first stage.
